entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: Indicates the user-plane resources of PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access allowed to be re-established over 3GPP access.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Registration request message sent by the UE.

entities.name: Response to paging with non-3GPP access type
entities.description: Condition where the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is sent as a response to paging with the access type indicating non-3GPP access.

entities.name: UE wants to indicate allowed PDU session re-establishment
entities.description: Condition where the UE wants to indicate the user-plane resources of PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access allowed to be re-established over 3GPP access.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the Allowed PDU session status IE under specific conditions.
Inclusion of Allowed PDU session status IE is guarded by the condition that the message is sent as a response to paging with non-3GPP access type.
Inclusion of Allowed PDU session status IE is guarded by the condition that the UE wants to indicate allowed PDU session re-establishment.
